items.title: India Launches Country Strategic Opportunities Program
items.whyInNews: The Government of India and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) have launched the Country Strategic Opportunities Program (COSOP) for 8 years, from 2026 to 2033, to strengthen the rural economy.
items.summary: The program aims to improve the livelihoods of rural people, with a focus on smallholder farmers and rural youth. The COSOP will be implemented in various states across India, with an emphasis on inclusive and sustainable development. The program will also promote climate-resilient agriculture and support rural entrepreneurship.

The IFAD will provide technical assistance and funding for the program

Historical context: India has been a member of IFAD since 1977 and has received funding for various rural development projects

Policy implication: The COSOP will contribute to India's goal of doubling farmers' incomes by 2025

items.title: India Maritime Insurance Pool Launched
items.whyInNews: The Department of Financial Services (DFS) has launched the India Maritime Insurance Pool (BMIP) with a sovereign guarantee of $1.4 billion (₹12,980 crore) to provide continuous marine insurance coverage.
items.summary: The BMIP will provide insurance coverage to Indian shipping companies and help reduce their insurance costs. The pool will also help to mitigate the risks associated with marine insurance and promote the growth of the Indian shipping industry. The launch of the BMIP is expected to boost India's maritime trade and economy.
